description: Live prices in one fast call for up to 25 assets: any coin by CoinGecko id or ticker symbol (btc, eth, sol, usdc...) and any Solana token by mint address. Returns price, 24h change, 24h high/low, market cap, volume, rank and the source, in USD or another currency. Cached at most 60 s; Binance and Jupiter as fallbacks. Price: 0.002 USDC per call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base or Solana, no account, no API key); invalid input is refused before payment and a failed run is never charged. Without a payment the tool returns the x402 PaymentRequired. How to call it: get_example {"tool":"crypto_price"}. Same tool over HTTP: https://yruz.one/api/crypto/price?ids=bitcoin%2Cethereum%2Csolana

ids.description: comma-separated coins or mints (required), e.g. btc,eth,sol or a Solana mint

vs.description: quote currency, default usd (eur, gbp, jpy, btc, eth ...)

name: crypto_price
title: YRUZ Crypto Price (0.002 USDC)
